Start date: 1486-08-25  
Subtract 38 weeks = 38 × 7 = 266 days.  
Add 6 more days to subtract → total subtract 272 days.  

1486 is not a leap year (divisible by 4 but not by 100 before 1582 exception? Actually, 1486 mod 4 = 2, so not leap year).  

Count back:  
August 25 minus 272 days.  
August has 31 days, so back to July: 25 days in Aug + 31 days in July = 56 days used, 272 − 56 = 216 days left.  
June has 30 days → 216 − 30 = 186 left.  
May has 31 → 186 − 31 = 155 left.  
April has 30 → 155 − 30 = 125 left.  
March has 31 → 125 − 31 = 94 left.  
February has 28 (1486 not leap) → 94 − 28 = 66 left.  
January has 31 → 66 − 31 = 35 left.  
December 1485 has 31 → 35 − 31 = 4 days left in November.  

November 1485 has 30 days, so 30 − 4 = 26 → date is 1485-11-26.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1485-11-26
